milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because crafting melon_seeds from a melon_slice is an inventory operation — the crafted item (melon_seeds) ends up in the player's inventory. The player starts with 1 melon_slice and 0 melon_seeds, so detecting melon_seeds >= 1 in inventory confirms the craft was completed. This is a 1x1 shapeless recipe that can be done in the 2x2 inventory grid or at the crafting table.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a golden_pickaxe from 3 gold_ingots and 2 sticks is an inventory operation — the crafted item (golden_pickaxe) ends up in the player's inventory. The player starts with 0 golden_pickaxes, so detecting golden_pickaxe >= 1 confirms the craft was completed. This requires the 3x3 crafting table grid (placed at ~2 ~0 ~2).
